description: Scaffold the Vite + React + TypeScript project with Tailwind CSS, PostCSS, the port-5317/host-0.0.0.0 dev+preview config, Google Fonts, and the 'sacred but modern' theme. Produces a minimal but running, buildable app shell that later features fill with content. Independent foundation feature; FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on it.
steps: Create package.json at the workspace root. name 'ave-jesus-rex', private true, type 'module'. scripts: "dev": "vite", "build": "tsc && vite build", "preview": "vite preview", "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit". dependencies: react ^18, react-dom ^18, react-router-dom ^6. devDependencies: vite ^5, @vitejs/plugin-react ^4, typescript ^5, tailwindcss ^3, postcss ^8, autoprefixer ^10, @types/react ^18, @types/react-dom ^18. Pin to concrete current patch versions (e.g. via `npm install <pkg>@latest`), not open wildcards.

Create tsconfig.json (strict: true, target ES2020, lib [ES2020, DOM, DOM.Iterable], module ESNext, moduleResolution 'bundler', jsx 'react-jsx', resolveJsonModule true, allowImportingTsExtensions false, noEmit true, isolatedModules true, skipLibCheck true, include ['src']) and tsconfig.node.json for the vite config (composite, module ESNext, moduleResolution bundler, include ['vite.config.ts']).

Create vite.config.ts: import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'; export default defineConfig({ plugins:[react()], server:{ host:'0.0.0.0', port:5317, strictPort:true }, preview:{ host:'0.0.0.0', port:5317, strictPort:true } }). The server block (host 0.0.0.0 + port 5317 + strictPort true) is MANDATORY and exact.

Create index.html at root: , , meta charset + viewport (width=device-width, initial-scale=1), title 'Ave Jesus Rex', , Google Fonts: preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com (crossorigin), then a stylesheet link for Cormorant Garamond (e.g. wght 400;500;600;700) and Inter (wght 400;500;600;700).
and

Create tailwind.config.js (ESM export default): content: ['./index.html','./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}']; theme.extend.colors: ink (deep navy/charcoal scale, e.g. base '#0f1724' or similar), parchment (warm off-white, e.g. '#f5efe1'), gold (amber/gold accent scale, e.g. '#c6a15b'); theme.extend.fontFamily.serif = ['"Cormorant Garamond"', 'Georgia', 'serif'], sans = ['Inter', 'system-ui', 'sans-serif'].
Create postcss.config.js (ESM export default) with plugins tailwindcss and autoprefixer.

Create src/index.css: @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities; plus a base layer that sets body background to the ink color, default text color (parchment/light), font-sans for body and font-serif usage for headings, and smooth defaults. Import this file at the top of src/main.tsx.
Create src/main.tsx (createRoot rendering <App/> inside React.StrictMode, importing ./index.css) and src/vite-env.d.ts (/// <reference types="vite/client" />).

Create a minimal src/App.tsx placeholder that renders a styled 'Ave Jesus Rex' heading using the serif font and theme colors, so the shell builds and visibly uses the theme. FEAT-002 replaces this with routing.
Create .gitignore (node_modules, dist, .DS_Store, *.local, logs). Do NOT run git init or commit.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` succeeds: tsc typecheck passes and vite produces a dist/ build with no errors.
vite.config.ts contains server host '0.0.0.0', port 5317, strictPort true (and the same for preview).
index.html references both Cormorant Garamond and Inter via Google Fonts and sets lang="en" and a mobile viewport meta.
tailwind.config.js defines the ink/parchment/gold colors and serif/sans font families; src/index.css includes the three @tailwind directives.
verification: Run `npm install` and confirm it exits 0.
Run `npm run build` and confirm it exits 0 with a dist/ output and no TypeScript errors.
Run `npm run typecheck` and confirm it passes.
findings:
SCAFFOLD COMPLETE. Node v20.20.2, npm 10.8.2. npm install, npm run build (tsc && vite build), and npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) all exit 0. dist/ produced (index.html + assets/*.css + assets/*.js). No server was started; port 5317 is free.

EXACT INSTALLED VERSIONS (package.json carets resolve to these; FEAT-002/003 should assume these APIs):
- react ^18.3.1, react-dom ^18.3.1 (NOT React 19 — `npm install @latest` initially pulled 19/router7; deliberately downgraded to satisfy the spec's react ^18 / react-router-dom ^6).
- react-router-dom ^6.30.6 (v6 API: createBrowserRouter/RouterProvider or <BrowserRouter><Routes><Route element=...>; useParams/useNavigate. Do NOT use v7-only APIs.).
- vite ^5.4.21, @vitejs/plugin-react ^4.7.0, typescript ^5.9.3, tailwindcss ^3.4.19, postcss ^8.5.29, autoprefixer ^10.6.1, @types/react ^18.3.31, @types/react-dom ^18.3.7.
- Known advisories: react-router-dom ^6 brings 2 transitive moderate advisories; vite/esbuild dev-only advisories reported by npm audit. Left as-is because versions are pinned to the spec majors. Do not `npm audit fix --force` (it would jump majors).

THEME TOKENS (tailwind.config.js theme.extend) — reuse these exact scales, do NOT invent new palettes:
- colors.ink: DEFAULT #0f1724; 50 #f3f5f8, 100 #e2e7ee, 200 #c3ccd9, 300 #9aa8bd, 400 #6c7e99, 500 #4e6080, 600 #3b4a63, 700 #2b374d, 800 #1a2335, 900 #0f1724, 950 #080d16. Body background = bg-ink-900, base text = text-parchment-100 (set in src/index.css @layer base).
- colors.parchment: DEFAULT #f5efe1; 50 #fdfbf6, 100 #f9f5ec, 200 #f5efe1, 300 #eadfc8, 400 #dccaa6, 500 #cbb282, 600 #b4976a, 700 #8f7652, 800 #6b5940, 900 #4a3e2e. Headings = text-parchment-50.
- colors.gold: DEFAULT #c6a15b; 50 #faf6ec, 100 #f3e9cf, 200 #e8d29f, 300 #dbb96e, 400 #c6a15b, 500 #b78a42, 600 #9c7036, 700 #7c552e, 800 #67472b, 900 #593e28. Gold accents/dividers used in App shell.
- fontFamily.serif = ['"Cormorant Garamond"','Georgia','serif'] (headings, via `font-serif`); fontFamily.sans = ['Inter','system-ui','sans-serif'] (body default). Fonts loaded in index.html via Google Fonts css2, weights 400;500;600;700 for BOTH families, display=swap.

STRENGTH BADGE COLOR SUGGESTION for FEAT-002 (not yet implemented): 'scriptural' -> gold, 'strong' -> ink-100/parchment, 'supplementary' -> muted ink — final choice is FEAT-002's.

FILE LAYOUT CREATED: root index.html, package.json, tsconfig.json, tsconfig.node.json (composite, references wired from tsconfig.json), vite.config.ts (server+preview host 0.0.0.0, port 5317, strictPort true), tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, .gitignore. src/main.tsx (StrictMode + createRoot, imports ./index.css first), src/App.tsx (placeholder 'Ave Jesus Rex' hero using serif + theme; FEAT-002 replaces with routing), src/index.css (3 @tailwind directives + @layer base for body bg/text/fonts/selection), src/vite-env.d.ts. No git initialized (per instructions). jsx runtime = 'react-jsx' so no React import needed in components.
